_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Production Line of Balance Status
summary: The DID describes the format for a line of balance report showing a contractor's current progress against planned objectives for the flow of materials and components into end items relative to phased delivery requirements.
description_purpose: The line of balance report describes the contractors current progress in a graphic form by comparison of planned objectives for flow of materials and components into manufacturer of end items as related to phased delivery requirements. This report is used as an indicator of the need of management decisions and corrective action.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This data item description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data as included in the contract.
7.2 This data item description may be applied in any production contract to acquire production line of balance status.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Contract.
preparation_instructions.content: This data item is generated by the contract which contains a specific work task to develop production line of balance status data.

preparation_instructions.title: Specific instructions.
preparation_instructions.content: The production line of balance status shall be graphically depicted as shown in figure 1. The graph shall be prepared for the production items as stated in the specific contract task and shall be supported with a narrative.
